_what_this_is: The durable floors for the two counters tools/next_ids.py allocates.
That tool takes max(every phase or finding number it finds in the
documents, in docs/, and in the open pull requests; these floors) + 1.
The floors exist so a number claimed by a pull request that was later
closed without merging is never handed out a second time. Nothing writes
this file automatically: bump a floor by hand, in the commit that retires
the numbers below it, when no document or pull request mentions it any more.
